title: Festive Countdown
description: Animated countdown to Christmas with snow, a snowman, a tree and Santa's sleigh.

enabled.description: Show the Festive Countdown in the rotation

display_duration.description: How long the countdown stays on screen each time (seconds)

number_color.description: Colour of the big countdown number (default: red)

label_color.description: Colour of the DAYS TO GO text (default: gold)

show_sleigh.description: Santa's sleigh flies across the sky

sleigh_every_seconds.description: How often the sleigh flies past (seconds)

snowflakes.description: How many snowflakes are falling (0 turns the snow off)

show_snowman.description: Show the snowman on the left

show_tree.description: Show the Christmas tree on the right

animation_fps.description: Animation frames per second. Lower it if the Pi struggles.
